subject: Verification: Prompt/output sanitization — evidence package and closure code
messages:
From: Daniel Wu <daniel.wu@finstream.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@finstream.com>, security@finstream.com
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final confirmation of prompt/output sanitization for FinStream (FS-42)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for walking us through the remediation plan last week. Our security team completed acceptance testing this morning and we need a final signed confirmation from Redwood that the following were executed for tenant FS-42: 

- Prompt inputs and generated outputs (prompt-output artifacts) removed from public/hosted KV caches and ephemeral logs
- Long-term logs trimmed per our agreed retention window and export hashes recorded
- A sealed evidence package with manifest and checksums delivered for our audit

Can you confirm completion and share the evidence package (or a secure download link) and the one-time closure code we agreed would be in the receipt? Ideally we need the confirmation and package today so we can attach it to our compliance ticket.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Security Operations
FinStream

Irene / team — confirmation below. Ops completed the sanitization sequence at 11:18 PT. Deliverables are attached and staged for secure download. Summary of actions performed (short):

1) KV cache sweep: targeted eviction for tenant FS-42 across region-us-1; continuous batching was paused for migration window and TTLs forced to zero for ephemeral stores. Eviction trace file: ops_ticket_SUP-4821.log
2) Prompt-output artifact prune: blob-level deletion from prompt-output store (s3 object deletions + tombstone manifest). Deleted object list included in evidence_manifest.csv inside the zip.
3) Retention trimming: consolidated long-term logs trimmed to the agreed retention date; export hashes calculated (SHA256) and recorded in manifest.json.
4) Evidence package: finstream_evidence_manifest_20261025.zip (contains manifest.json, checksums.txt, deleted_object_list.csv, ops_ticket_SUP-4821.log)
5) Closure receipt: closure_receipt_FS-42.txt — contains closure code and signed timestamp

Attached: finstream_evidence_manifest_20261025.zip (171 KB, archive)
Attached: ops_ticket_SUP-4821.log (12 KB, text)
Attached: closure_receipt_FS-42.txt (1 KB, text)

Closure code (also in receipt): RC-6K9Z-20261025
Evidence package S3 link (presigned, expires in 7 days): s3://redwood-evidence/FS-42/20261025/evidence_manifest.zip
Jira ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4821

Let me know if FinStream wants a signed PDF as well (we can DocuSign the receipt).

—Marissa
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference

Irene / Marissa — thank you, that looks thorough. A couple quick clarifications before we close ticket FS-42:

- Can you confirm the KV eviction covered both in-memory and on-disk caches (not just serving layer)?
- In the manifest.json can you include the retention-trim delta (number of records/pruned per log file)?
- Please provide the SHA256 digest for the closure_receipt_FS-42.txt (we'll store the digest in our evidence vault)

If you can add those three items to the package, we can accept and close. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Daniel
